title: agy.json duplicates agy-tmux.json's model_tier_map — point it at the family table via model_tier_map_from
summary: The agy family declares its tier→model table twice (agy.json headless + agy-tmux.json), the exact per-transport duplication the 2026-09-09 codex cutover removed for codex (architecture review HIGH: codex.json sat three model generations stale behind its copy). LoadManifest now resolves an explicit `model_tier_map_from` pointer, so agy.json can drop its map and point at agy-tmux.json.
fix: Delete model_tier_map from agy.json, add "model_tier_map_from": "agy-tmux", and add a relational test (LoadManifest("agy") table == loadManifestRaw("agy-tmux") table; raw agy.json declares none). Sweep readers of LoadManifest("agy") for any that need the raw map. claude-p is NOT in scope: it legitimately declares no map (tiers are its selectors).
acceptance: agy.json declares no model_tier_map and carries model_tier_map_from: agy-tmux
LoadManifest("agy").ModelTierMap equals loadManifestRaw("agy-tmux").ModelTierMap (relational test, no literal ids)
